description:
Create a new Concept Class in the OpenMRS Administration interface with the following details:
- Name: 'PRAPARE Assessment'
- Description: 'Social determinants of health assessment concepts'
- Short Name / Abbreviation: 'PRAPARE'

Navigate to the OpenMRS Administration interface (typically found via the browser address bar at /openmrs/admin), log in with username 'superman' and password 'Admin123', find the 'Manage Concept Classes' section, and add the new class.
